title: Middle East live: Netanyahu says US-Iran ceasefire does not include Lebanon
summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claimed that the two-week US-Iran ceasefire struck late on Tuesday does not include Lebanon. The last-minute diplomacy effort led by Pakistan halts planned US strikes, with talks set to begin in Islamabad on Friday. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
contentText: The Israeli military renewed its strikes on southern Lebanon on Wednesday, state media reported, as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisted the US-Iran ceasefire agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz did not include Lebanon. French President Emmanuel Macron has called for Lebanon’s inclusion in the truce deal. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
